checks.note: Authentication page: private apps use API key, public apps must use OAuth2 ("mandatory"). Basic is not named on the page (inference stays flagged). Scopes page not opened.

Pricing page FAQ states a 7-day trial with all features and no payment info needed; no free plan found (lowest is Starter, paid). API tier availability is not stated on the vendor page, so that caveat stays open. Rate limits page: API key 40 req/20s (=2/s), OAuth2 80 req/20s.
llms.txt lists 23 REST resource groups plus Reporting Statistics (Tickets, Customers, Macros, Rules, Tags, Teams, Users, Views, Voice Calls, etc.). Broad is reasonable.

Official help article gives https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp with browser auth and all Helpdesk plans. Open beta is confirmed on the vendor changelog; reads live, macro edits and AI Agent config writes gated.
ready_with_caveats fits: trial-only access with no free tier, an unconfirmed API plan tier, and an MCP in beta with some writes gated. The rate limit caveat is now vendor-verified (API key 40/20s).

corrected.one_liner: Gorgias is a helpdesk for ecommerce merchants that centralizes support tickets from email, chat, social and voice alongside Shopify/store order data, with automation and AI agents.
corrected.auth_notes: Private apps use an API key (account email as username plus API key; HTTP Basic is an inference, not named on the page). Public apps must use OAuth2. The vendor MCP server uses browser OAuth.
corrected.access_notes: Vendor pricing page FAQ: 7-day free trial with all features, no payment info required. No free plan found; the lowest paid plan is Starter. The vendor page does not say which plans include API access. Rate limits (vendor page): API key 40 requests per 20 seconds (about 2/s); OAuth2 apps 80 per 20 seconds; HTTP 429 on excess.
corrected.blocker: No free tier; credentials come from a 7-day trial and then a paid plan. API plan tier is unconfirmed. Rate limit is about 2 req/s for API keys. Public multi-tenant apps must use OAuth2. The official MCP server is in open beta, with macro edits and AI Agent configuration writes gated.
